statements.t: UTMD’s 3Q 2026 Gross Profit margin (GPM) was lower than in 3Q 2025 because WW trade shipments were lower while the Company retained the same previous labor and overhead staffing that it previously had in order to support the anticipated substantial new growth in biopharma control device manufacturing.

risks.t: government intervention in healthcare and the economy in general such as tariffs
the Company’s ability to efficiently manufacture
cybersecurity and foreign currency exchange rates
among other factors that have been and will be outlined in UTMD’s public disclosure filings with the SEC
